title: Rebase rule: do not let a roll-up move VMM backwards
summary: A later oorexxapis archive is an integration source, not automatic authority over VMM versions. Compare exact component versions and qualification evidence; retain newer VMM/runtime/UI work when a roll-up contains an older bundled copy.
invariants: Current runtime baseline is VMM v0.11 unless explicitly superseded.
Current UI baseline is VMM Wire UI Web v0.3 unless explicitly superseded.
Dependency advances may be adopted selectively after compatibility qualification.
Do not infer that unrelated newer component versions imply VMM compatibility without testing.
Preserve existing protocol versions unless the interface itself changes.

provenance.claim: Current runtime candidate and unchanged protocol map; later roll-ups are integration inputs, not automatic VMM supersession.
